data.text: The board microphone is active only from a button press until the speaker stops talking (about 1.2 s of quiet after speech, 4 s if nobody speaks, 10 s hard cap). It is never always-on. A press while the agent is thinking or speaking is stopped immediately and discarded so the agent does not hear itself.
data.rationale: User explicitly required the mic to be on only when the buttons are pressed, because the agent kept listening for a long time and picked up its own speech.

evidence: do not make the mic always running - should only be when pressing the buttons

data.title: Use the physical board microphone as voice input

evidence: the mic should only be active right after pressing the button and shut down afterwards.
